contents.text: I've sent this case to a person on the payments team. The refund for order 1005 failed with a `System.ArgumentOutOfRangeException` (startIndex -4 in `OrderApi.RefundOrder`, `Api/Refund.cs` line 12). The refund runbook doesn't list that exception as expected, and its Decisions table sends every unlisted exception to payments with no automatic fix. Payments needs to check whether the customer was actually refunded, since this operation moves money. I didn't investigate further or touch any code.
